text: My dad passed away two weeks ago. Everyone keeps telling me he's in a better place, but I just feel numb and can't even cry. Is something wrong with me?
I got laid off today after eight years at the same company. I have a mortgage and two kids and I honestly don't know how I'm going to tell my wife.
I moved to a new city for work three months ago and I haven't made a single friend. Most evenings I just sit in my apartment and scroll my phone. I feel invisible.
I failed my final exam even though I studied for weeks. My friends all passed. I feel so stupid and I'm thinking of quitting the program.
I just found out my paper got accepted at the conference I've been dreaming about for years! I'm shaking and don't know who to tell first!
I'm so tired. Work, kids, my mother's care — every day is the same loop and nobody notices how much I'm carrying. I snapped at my daughter today and I hate myself for it.
The doctor says the biopsy results will be back on Friday. I can't sleep or eat. I keep imagining the worst.
She ended our five-year relationship over a text message. I keep replaying everything I did wrong. I don't know how to stop.
My manager took credit for my project in front of the whole leadership team. I'm furious and I want to send an email I know I'll regret.
I finally put my mom in a care home because I couldn't cope anymore. She cried when I left. I feel like I abandoned her.
I froze during my presentation today in front of 100 people and had to walk off stage. I want to disappear.
It's my first festival away from my family and the whole hostel is empty. Everyone's video call looks so happy and I just want to go home.
